name: squiggle
description: Squiggle - Critical analysis and editorial verification browser extension (Chrome MV3 & Firefox MV3)

scripts.build:chrome: TARGET=chrome vite build && node scripts/build-content-script.mjs dist/chrome
scripts.build:firefox: TARGET=firefox vite build && node scripts/build-content-script.mjs dist/firefox
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:web
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w @squiggle/server && npm run test -w @squiggle/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @squiggle/server && npm run typecheck -w @squiggle/web
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @squiggle/server -- staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @squiggle/server -- production
